description: Compares the official 2026 property assessment (ejendomsvurdering), which sets the property tax from 2027, with the statistical market estimate for the same home, against the statutory 20 % rule that lets an owner ask for a reassessment. Returns the assessment, the estimate at the assessment date, the deviation, a verdict and the yearly tax at stake. Takes an address_id from search_address. A cold lookup can take up to a minute.
name: get_assessment_check
title: Check a home's 2026 property assessment
